name: Hotel Moarhof
beschreibung: Hotel Moarhof is located in the sunny town of Lienz in East Tyrol, nestled beneath the dramatic Lienz Dolomites. The hotel combines authentic Tyrolean wood furnishings with a tranquil, hospitable ambiance. It serves as an ideal base for summer hiking and biking tours in the Hohe Tauern National Park and winter skiing on Zettersfeld and Hochstein. Amenities include a restorative wellness area with sauna and an acclaimed regional restaurant.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Moarhof in Lienz in East Tyrol features traditional alpine decor, a relaxing sauna area, fine regional dining, and stunning views of the Lienz Dolomites.
